faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the AIIMS Delhi Clinical Research Coordinator recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email is 25th September 2026. Ensure your application reaches before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the salary offered for the Clinical Research Coordinator post?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 25,000 per month for the contractual period.

faq.question: Q3. What are the minimum educational qualifications required?
faq.answer: Candidates need a Bachelor's degree in a relevant subject with 2 years of experience, or a Master's degree in a relevant subject, or be a Nursing Graduate with relevant experience.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q5. What is the maximum age limit for the Clinical Research Coordinator position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for this post is 35 years.

faq.question: Q6. Are there any age relaxations available?
faq.answer: Yes, age relaxation is provided: 5 years for SC/ST candidates and 3 years for OBC candidates.

faq.question: Q7. How will candidates be selected for the Clinical Research Coordinator role?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve shortlisting of applications followed by an interview.

faq.question: Q8. What is the mode of application for this job?
faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted via email. Candidates need to send their complete application along with required documents to the specified email address.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent or contractual job?
faq.answer: This is a contractual job opportunity at AIIMS Delhi.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification can be accessed through the 'Official Notification PDF' link provided in the Important Links section of this article.
